tasks.prompt: Replace a legacy global text filter with the supported namespaced filter contract while preserving its marker replacement behavior.

Add a Moodle 5.2 question-bank bulk action gated by qbank/momopda:use. The first valid POST must show an explicit, non-mutating confirmation for the selected questions. A distinct confirmed POST must revalidate the sesskey, originating activity-backed bank context, action capability, and edit permission for every selected question before atomically marking exactly those question versions as draft. Successful and cancelled requests must return to a validated local originating question-bank URL, with a server-built local fallback for missing or unsafe targets.

Add a tiny_momopda TinyMCE toolbar button, advertise it as tiny_momopda/tiny_momopda, place it in the content toolbar section, and localize its tooltip through tiny_momopda/buttontitle. Activating the button must execute the mceMomopdaInsertMarker command, which uses editor.insertContent() to insert exactly <mark class="tiny_momopda-marker">MoMoPDA</mark> at the current selection.

Add a required per-instance mode setting to mod_momopda. Localize it through mod_momopda/mode, mod_momopda/modestandard, and mod_momopda/modeguided. Display it as a required select containing exactly Standard (1) and Guided (2), with no empty option and Standard selected by default. Persist submitted values when an activity is added or updated. On fresh installations, define momopda.mode as an integer of length 1, NOT NULL, with database default 1. Upgrade from plugin version 2026081900 to exactly 2026081901 by adding the same field only when absent so every existing activity receives 1, then call upgrade_mod_savepoint(true, 2026081901, 'momopda'). This setting does not require view changes.
Add an external function that returns one course summary only to users allowed to view that course.
Convert the information item into a one-line response question and render submitted text safely during attempts and review.
Show a paginated report of recently active users using portable Moodle DML and localized table headings.
Allow course managers to add and remove an enrolment instance with a configurable active date range.
